hyperparameters.method: Poisson / NB2 binned / discretised normal / empirical ratio (quantile mapping) / minutes mixture / single-minutes NB; parameters from development; validation log score, CRPS, PIT, rungs.

hypothesis: A mixture over minutes scenarios of NB(rate x minutes) is better calibrated than a single NB at the mean minutes (which ignores minutes risk).
limitations: Chosen: empirical. The single-minutes NB is the overconfident case (PIT variance > 1); minutes uncertainty must be propagated.
